main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar return minus coin's normal 5-bar drift on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; over at least 100 grid cases with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: book's timing gain before costs (mean daily gain minus coin-rise part)

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2 (no confirm or reject rule met).
reading: All grid cases (forecast 0 included) enter the pooled regression, the drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all its windows, and the timing gain uses the position before costs (allocation x next-bar return) minus allocation x the coin's mean daily return, averaged over coins per day then over days.
